description: This file defines the ResultVisitor interface used for evaluating the results of command strategies within the Eclipse Ditto project. It declares methods for handling different result types such as empty, mutation, query, and error, with relevant parameters including commands, events, headers, and exceptions.

classes.name: ResultVisitor
classes.description: An interface for evaluating command results in Ditto, supporting methods for handling empty, mutation, query, and error cases with relevant parameters.

methods.name: onEmpty
methods.description: Default method to handle empty results; does nothing by default.

methods.name: onMutation
methods.description: Handles mutation results, with parameters for the command, event, response headers, and flags for creation and deletion behaviors.

methods.name: onQuery
methods.description: Handles query results, with parameters for the command and response headers.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Handles error results, with parameters for the error exception and the command that caused it.
